source_ts_ns.meaning: Time the source says the market action occurred; Binance T or Bybit cts when present.

exchange_ts_ns.meaning: Time the exchange says it published the message; Binance E or Bybit ts.
exchange_ts_ns.fallback: receive_ts_ns only when the venue omits exchange time (a Binance REST depth snapshot always does); the live service counts these as exchange_ts_substituted per venue, the event is not flagged

receive_ts_ns.meaning: Local wall-clock time of the frame. Without arrival stamping (the default, and every recording before 17 Nov 2026): the time the frame was taken up for PROCESSING, so event-loop lag is folded into it. With arrival stamping (LiveFeedSettings.arrival_stamp, profile key oms.session_limits.feed_arrival_stamp, v1_10 onward): the time the frame ARRIVED from the connection, before it waited for processing.

observed_ts_ns.meaning: Time at which a host-clock reference sample was observed.

receive_mono_ns.meaning: Monotonic-clock stamp taken at the frame's arrival, on the wire record (wire_schema_version 1.1.0) and on the trace row of its canonical event. Present only with arrival stamping on. Not comparable across processes or restarts; used for intervals (arrival to processing, silence), never as a time of day.
receive_mono_ns.fallback: absent without arrival stamping; the canonical MarketEvent itself carries no monotonic field (the trace row links it)

processing (not stored per event).meaning: With arrival stamping the service keeps the largest arrival-to-processing interval and the largest backlog per venue (arrival_stats) instead of a per-event processing stamp.

decision_ts_ns / route_decision_ts_ns.meaning: Paper and live DECISION rows (paper_timestamps.jsonl): wall clock when the strategy decided and when the route was decided. In a replay they are simulated time.

ledger ts_ns.meaning: The OMS and ledger stamp every record with one ts_ns: event (simulated) time in a replay, the session's wall clock in paper and live. Send, acknowledgement and execution times are not separate named fields in the ledger (audit A1 1.5: still a gap).

derived_measurements.cross_venue_skew_ns: absolute difference between latest receive_ts_ns values for the same instrument
derived_measurements.corrected_delay_ns: event_latency_ns - host_offset_estimate_ns (the time monitor's low-quantile estimate, min(0, q1%)); stored next to, never over, the raw stamps (feed-health rollup delay_ms)
derived_measurements.own_lag_ns: processing_now_ns - receive_ts_ns with arrival stamping on (how long the frame waited for the processor); 0 in a replay
derived_measurements.clock_reference_offset_ns: local_midpoint_of_the_best_probe - venue_server_time (A3 server-time probe, five round trips, lowest wins); uncertainty = half that round trip; the host clock monitor's independent reference

cross_venue_alignment: Compare latest local receive timestamps using a configured tolerance; never rewrite venue timestamps.
replay_clock: The current event receive_ts_ns is simulated now; processing speed must not affect results.
